purpose: Triggers an action or submits a form. The primary interactive element for user-initiated operations.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis: contained (filled), outlined or text. Defaults to contained. primary, secondary, ghost and danger are deprecated aliases (see deprecatedVariants)

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role. danger is only for destructive actions. Defaults to primary

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents interaction and applies disabled styling

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner over the hidden label, keeps the width and blocks activation

props.name: type
props.description: HTML button type. Defaults to button

whenToUse: To trigger an action such as saving, deleting, or submitting
As the primary call to action on a page or dialog
To confirm or cancel a destructive operation
whenNotToUse: For navigation — use a link or anchor element instead
When the action opens a new page or external URL — use a link
As a tab or toggle — use the appropriate tab or toggle component
antiPatterns: Using more than one contained primary button in the same view
Using the danger tone for non-destructive actions
Nesting a button inside another button

anatomy: Optional leading icon (`iconStart`), label, optional trailing icon; while loading a spinner is drawn over the hidden label so the width holds
states: contained: `color-interactive-default` fill, `color-interactive-hover` on hover, `color-interactive-active` when pressed
danger tone: `color-text-danger` fill or `color-text-danger-action` text over `color-state-layer-danger`
motion: Colour changes over `motion-duration-standard` with `motion-easing-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Must have a visible text label or an aria-label when icon-only
disabled prop must set aria-disabled and prevent focus, not remove from tab order
loading uses React Aria's pending state: stays focusable, aria-disabled, blocks activation and form submission, and announces a Loading progress bar to screen readers
Target size at least 24x24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8); the smallest button is 32px tall
Focus ring must be visible and use color-interactive-focus-ring
